name: How long does a typical stair repair project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical stair repair project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a stair repair project varies significantly based on the extent of the damage, the type of materials involved, and the complexity of the staircase design. Simple repairs like replacing a few treads might take a day or two, while more extensive structural repairs or a complete refurbishment could span several days to a week or more. During our initial consultation, Frasheski Construction provides an estimated timeline after assessing the specific condition of your stairs and the required work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stair repair duration depends on damage extent and complexity, ranging from a day for minor fixes to over a week for structural repairs. We provide an estimate after assessment.
